name: Crew Chief
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Crew Chief turns AI coding sessions into one attention queue, so a run waiting for you cannot hide behind terminal tabs. Claude Code, Codex, Herdr, and command-capable tools report working, blocked, or done. The bar hides when idle, counts work, and flashes NEEDS YOU. The panel sorts blocked work first, shows project, harness, age, and prompt, then focuses its terminal or dismisses it. Only bounded lifecycle metadata enters a local spool. No network, account, key, telemetry, or transcript reads.
